items.title: Coinone warns of phishing, identity theft after customer data breach
items.snippet: The South Korean crypto exchange said potentially exposed information includes passwords, bank account numbers, national identification numbers and crypto wallet addresses.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: RWA protocol stUSDT winds down three years after $2.3B TVL peak
items.snippet: The stUSDT team did not disclose a reason for winding down the RWA protocol but assured holders that all underlying assets remain fully backed.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto
items.snippet: XRP tanked to its lowest level since November 2024 as ETF outflows and shrinking stablecoin supply add to pressure on crypto markets.
